_doc: Layered stop criteria (user 2026-10-23). A skill is DONE when every gate in generic + its family + its task passes AND tracking fidelity has converged. Gates the decider adds while iterating go to the task scope (decision field stop_gates_add). Metrics: eval.* = best checkpoint's eval json; robust.* = robustness json success rate; sim2sim.* = native MuJoCo success rate; critic.max_unwaived_severity = worst library check of the task after waivers (decision field waive: [{check, reason}]). value_ref may use ref_flight_s (reference flight duration).

generic.why: no stepping in the final rest pose
no large unexplained deviation from the reference
pushes, friction, CoM, encoder bias, noise
control latency of a real robot

convergence.why: fidelity curriculum: stop tightening when the body tracking error stops improving
